properties.displayName: Deny Creating and Modifying Protected Networking Resources
properties.description: This Policy will prevent users from creating Express Route circuits, VPN Sites, VPN/NAT/Local Gateways, Route Tables or Network Security Perimeters. It also prevents route child-resource operations (e.g. edit/delete).

nonComplianceMessages.message: Deploying Express Route circuits, VPN Sites, VPN/NAT/Local Gateways, Route Tables, or Network Security Perimeters in the Landing Zones is not allowed.
